mode: D — checker drove its own browser
note: Written alongside the pre-existing report.json in this directory, which belongs to a different checker run (base http://127.0.0.1:8301, 15/17, generated_classes empty). That file was read as data and NOT trusted, overwritten, or relied on: every result below was produced by this checker. The other run's empty `generated_classes` is explained — its environment had no model provider, so `generate` correctly returned its no-provider refusal.

instrument.fixture: scratch project `checkerdemo` with a DRAFT login FlowSpec built from the real schema (.work/checker-setup-flowspec.py); left in DRAFT deliberately so the review gate is exercised through the UI, not bypassed

criteria.claim: a project with no FlowSpec renders a page that states so and offers >=1 way onward
the review gate refuses an unsigned approval and changes nothing
criteria.evidence: clicked Approve with an empty name -> 400; flowspec on disk still status=draft, by=None

criteria.claim: the gate moves in both directions from the UI
criteria.evidence: signed Approve in the browser -> status=approved, by=checker-mode-d, at=2026-09-09T05:40:15Z, note persisted. Then request-edit with name+reason -> 303, status=needs_edit, attributed.

criteria.claim: free-text review fields go through the credential guard (U8/U9)
criteria.evidence: posted the real GEMINI_API_KEY value from .env as a review note -> 400 'looks like it contains a real credential'. The value was never printed to the transcript.

criteria.claim: Generate refuses as a themed page (not raw JSON) with no FlowSpec, when unapproved (X1), or with no provider; and writes no cases
criteria.evidence: no-flowspec -> 400 themed page 'Nothing to generate from'; unapproved -> 400 themed page 'The flowspec is not approved yet'; cases on disk stayed 0 after both.

criteria.claim: every coverage gap from a run or crawl becomes exactly one VideoRequest (V1-V3)
criteria.evidence: crawl of checkerdemo -> req_bb8e26317632 'Record a short video showing the screen/flow at /'. THE FIRST VideoRequest EVER CREATED IN THIS PRODUCT. A second crawl left the count at exactly 1 (V3 idempotency).

criteria.claim: both new GET routes escape project data (U5)
criteria.evidence: project named <script>alert(1)</script>&'\" -> /flowspec and /requests each returned 0 raw payload occurrences and 2 escaped; the <title> is escaped too (<script>...), which was the maker's own noted mistake #1 and is genuinely fixed.

headline_result.claim: EXPAND is reachable from a button and produces best / worst / edge
headline_result.evidence: Clicked 'Generate cases' on the approved flowspec. ~120s of real model calls produced 10 cases across 10 DISTINCT taxonomy classes from one login flow: happy (best); auth_wrong_creds (worst); input_empty, input_boundary, input_unicode_oversize, double_submit, back_refresh_midflow, network_offline_slow, viewport_mobile, deeplink_unauth (edge). A second generate left the count at exactly 10 — content-addressed, idempotent.
headline_result.significance: Before this unit, all four projects held 52 cases of which 50 were 'happy' and NONE had been generated. This is the first time the product has produced a test case.

findings.summary: review-gate refusals are raw JSON while generate refusals are themed pages — inconsistent within the same file

console_errors: 1 per page, all GET /favicon.ico 404 (AT-248, pre-existing and already filed). No other console error on any page driven.
